game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ember mage's power beats the shield shown by smoke serpents.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ember mage's power beats the shield shown by smoke serpents. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ember mage ahead. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the magma valve by solving code steps involving power that move the ember mage forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the magma valve first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
